title: Advanced Directives: v-html, v-text, v-once & More
description: Explore special directives that give you fine control over rendering and performance.

slides.content:
## v-html Renders raw HTML (be careful!): ```html
``` ## v-text Sets the text content (like `{{ }}` but avoids interpolation flicker): ```html ```

slides.title: v-once: One-Time Render
slides.content:
`v-once` renders the element and its children **only once**. Subsequent data changes won't update it. ```html

{{ staticMessage }}

``` Great for content that never changes, improving performance.

slides.title: v-pre and v-cloak
slides.content:
## v-pre Skips compilation for this element and its children – useful for raw Mustache tags you don't want Vue to process. ```html {{ this won't be compiled }} ``` ## v-cloak Stays on the element until the Vue instance is mounted, used to hide uncompiled mustache tags. ```html
{{ message }}
```

quizData.question: What does `v-once` do?

options.text: It makes an element appear only once
It renders the element only once and never updates it
It creates a one-time event listener

quizData.explanation: `v-once` ensures the element is rendered once and not updated when data changes. Good for performance optimization.
